The exact same character shown in the reference images: Lume, an original stylized 3D animated mascot, a small furry creature (image 1 is the original design, image 2 is the approved straight-on front view of the same character). Keep his design exactly: soft golden-peach fur; lighter cream muzzle, chest and belly; large round ears with pink interiors; large round blue eyes with big black pupils, white highlights and small lashes at the outer corners; dark expressive eyebrows; glossy pink-red nose; rosy pink cheeks; long thin dark whiskers; a brown swept-up hair tuft on top of the head; two small upper front teeth; a large head on a compact rounded body with a round belly, short limbs and rounded paws with the same stubby fingers and toes as the references; a fluffy golden-peach tail with a purple tip. Same 3D animated-film rendering style, same colours, same soft detailed fur texture, same head-to-body proportions as the references. Friendly happy expression with the same open smile showing the two small front teeth.

VIEW: strict side profile of the whole body. His head, chest, belly and feet all point at the RIGHT edge of the image; the camera sees only his own right side. In profile he keeps his look: a large round head, a short rounded muzzle that protrudes gently forward with the glossy pink-red nose at its tip, a full rounded cheek with the rosy patch, whiskers fanning out from the muzzle, one large blue eye with its dark eyebrow, the open smile with the front teeth seen from the side, one large round ear standing up from the side of the head with its pink interior facing outward-forward, and the brown hair tuft sweeping up on top. Do not lengthen the snout. His round belly curves forward in silhouette; the near arm hangs relaxed at his side. Tail in this view: behind him on the LEFT side of the image, attached at the lower back and sweeping away from the camera toward his far side, so it is partly hidden behind his body with the purple tip visible.

Tail anatomy, identical in every view: one tail, attached at the base of his spine at the centre of his lower back, sweeping out toward his own LEFT side and curling slightly upward, golden-peach with a purple tip. Do not move the tail to another place on the body.

FULL BODY at the same scale as reference image 2: he stands upright in a relaxed neutral stance, arms relaxed and held slightly away from his body with the paws lowered beside his hips, feet flat on the floor. The whole character is inside the frame with a margin of empty background on every side: ears, hair tuft, whiskers, paws, feet and any visible part of the tail.

Warm ivory seamless studio background, soft even studio lighting, soft contact shadow under the feet. Camera level at the height of his chest, no wide-angle distortion. Bare base design: no hat, no clothing, no book, no accessories. No props, no text, no logos, no watermark. Do not add new markings, stripes or spots. Do not change him into a different animal.
